title: BUSINESS OVERVIEW
description: Blue Star is one of India’s leading integrated MEP service providers, with over 80 years of project experience while delivering expert HVACR solutions across the Building, Industrial, and Infrastructure segments. The Company’s Electro-Mechanical Projects Group (EMPG) has built a strong reputation over the past couple of decades as a one-stop turnkey provider of both integrated and discrete MEP services, managing large-scale projects for airports, hospitals, hotels, retail malls, commercial complexes, factories, data centres, electrical substations, railway electrification, and rural water supply. Supported by a robust global supply chain and a commitment to excellence, Blue Star’s EMPG has successfully contributed to engineering marvels across diverse geographies, earning the trust of clients worldwide.

title: VRF SYSTEMS
description: A VRF (Variable Refrigerant Flow) air conditioning system is an advanced central air conditioning solution in which one outdoor unit connects to multiple indoor units through refrigerant piping. The system intelligently controls refrigerant flow based on cooling demand, ensuring precise temperature control across different zones.

title: PROCESS CHILLERS
description: Blue Star offers Process Chillers for medical, pharmaceutical industries and varied industrial applications like plastic mould cooling, printing and lamination processes. title: COOLER-CUM-FREEZER
description: Our Cooler-Cum-Freezers are the ultimate solution for storing a diverse range of frozen foods and chilled beverages in a single unit. It seamlessly integrates two functions by providing separate compartments for the freezer and cooling chamber. This not only maximises space but also reduces capital investment and operating costs. A seamless blend of innovation and efficiency, delivering exceptional value.
